email_body:
Dear Ms. Fort,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Intern position at EERA AISBL, as advertised. With a background in digital marketing, content creation, and web management, I am excited about the opportunity to support EERA's communication activities at the intersection of research and EU policy.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I have also developed visual materials using Canva and have experience with email marketing and social media scheduling. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to create engaging content and optimize for search engines, including AI-driven platforms.

I am particularly drawn to EERA's mission to catalyze low-carbon energy research. I am keen to apply my skills to help communicate research findings to EU institutions and stakeholders, and to contribute to the clean energy transition.

I am legally entitled to work in the EU and am available for a six-month internship. My CV and a sample LinkedIn post are attached.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Ms. Fort,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Communications Intern position at EERA AISBL. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, web management, and social media, I am eager to contribute to EERA's mission of catalyzing Europe's low-carbon energy research.

In my current role at Episto, I have honed skills directly relevant to this internship. I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build and maintain WordPress websites using Elementor and Astra. I regularly use Canva to create visual assets and have experience with email marketing platforms like Mailchimp. My ability to produce clear, audience-appropriate content is demonstrated by my work on mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page site and implemented structured data to enhance visibility across search engines, including AI-powered ones.

I am particularly motivated by EERA's position at the intersection of research and EU policymaking. My interest in sustainability and EU affairs aligns with EERA's work. I am eager to learn how research evidence is translated into policy-relevant messages and to support the dissemination of EERA's activities to diverse stakeholders.

I am legally entitled to work in the EU and am available for a six-month internship. I am a quick learner, detail-oriented, and able to work autonomously. I am excited about the opportunity to grow in a Brussels-based EU policy environment.

Please find attached my CV and a sample LinkedIn post. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to EERA's communication team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
